sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.needToken: Save a gateway token to manage sessions.
sessions.noSessionsDescription: Start a conversation in Chat; sessions will appear here.

cron.title: Scheduled Tasks
cron.subtitle: Tasks run automatically on schedule and can be triggered manually anytime. Describe what you want to do regularly in any chat to create one quickly.
cron.needToken: Save a gateway token to manage scheduled tasks.
cron.wakeBanner: Scheduled tasks only run while this device is awake. When the system or display sleeps, runs may be skipped.
cron.wakeLockUnavailable: Screen wake lock is not available in this browser or context.
cron.emptyHistoryHint: Records will appear here once scheduled tasks start running.
cron.name: Name *
cron.runHistoryHint: Completed runs are stored on disk (state/cron/runs). Use Refresh to update.
cron.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this cron job?
cron.emptyStateHint: Create a job to send on a cron schedule—directly or via the agent.
cron.deliveryTargetLocalChannel: Local channel — transcript or message stays on this machine
cron.recipientPlaceholder: Telegram: numeric id, or pick from recent sessions
cron.scheduleHintPreset: Select a preset or enter custom cron expression

schedulePicker.customCronHint: Five-field cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week

cron.modeDirect: Send message directly to the channel without AI processing
cron.modeAgent: Use AI agent to process the message, then send the response
cron.modeAgentOption: AI Agent (process with AI then send)
cron.agentLocalOnly: Local only (save transcript, no channel send)
cron.agentLocalOnlyHint: Runs the agent on this machine. Conversation is stored as a session (key cron:<job id>) with type cron; no Telegram or CLI delivery.
cron.deliveryLocalOnly: Local only — transcript saved under session key cron:<job id>
cron.enterManuallyOrSelect: Enter manually or select from recent chats
cron.noRecentChats: No recent chats found. Enter chat ID manually (e.g., 123456789 for Telegram)

workspace.openElsewhereHint: Preview may be limited or unavailable. Download the file or open it with another app.
workspace.cannotPreviewType: This file type can't be previewed here.

skills.title: Skills
skills.needToken: Save a gateway token to manage skills.
skills.tagline: Install and manage skills to extend xopc in conversation. Managed skills live under ~/.xopc/skills.
skills.marketplacePlaceholder: The skill marketplace is coming soon.
skills.installModalDropHint: Drop a .zip or SKILL.md file, or click to choose.
skills.installModalReq2: Or drop a SKILL.md file directly
skills.deleteMessage: Remove folder "{{id}}" from managed skills? This cannot be undone.
skills.detailModalBanner: The following is the original SKILL.md for this skill.

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Runtime diagnostics and history from the gateway.
logs.needToken: Save a gateway token to view logs.
logs.noLogsDescription: Adjust filters or search, or try again later.
logs.statsHint: Counts are sampled from recent log files, not totals.
logs.filtersDialogDesc: Time range and custom log levels.
logs.levelCustomHint: Toggle to include or exclude. No selection means all levels.

agentSettings.subtitle: Defaults for models, workspace, sampling, and how responses are shown.
agentSettings.sectionDesc: Changes are written to your gateway config file. Some values apply on the next agent turn or session.
agentSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to load and change agent defaults.
agentSettings.cardModelsSubtitle: Chat, vision, and image generation defaults
agentSettings.cardWorkspaceSubtitle: Working directory and inbound media limits
agentSettings.cardGenerationSubtitle: Token budget, randomness, and tool loop depth

desc.modelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary model returns an error after transient retries. Requires API keys for each provider.
desc.imageModel: Optional. Used for image understanding / vision.
desc.imageModelFallbacks: When the chat model has no vision, these vision models describe inbound images (and for the image tool). Tried in order.
desc.imageGenerationModelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary image generation model fails (e.g. quota or provider error).
desc.mediaMaxMb: Max size when loading images in the image tool.
desc.browserEnabled: Exposes Playwright browser_* tools to the model. Install Chromium once on the gateway host: npx playwright install chromium.
desc.browserHeadless: When off, Chromium shows a window on the gateway machine (useful for debugging). When on, runs in the background.
desc.maxTokens: Maximum tokens in the model response.
desc.maxToolIterations: Maximum tool calls per user message.
desc.thinkingDefault: Default thinking level for new sessions.
desc.reasoningDefault: Whether to surface model reasoning in the chat UI. Per-session overrides (e.g. /reasoning) take precedence until cleared.
desc.verboseDefault: Agent verbosity for logs/tool detail elsewhere — not the reasoning/thinking panel. Use Reasoning visibility to hide reasoning.

agentsSettings.title: Agents
agentsSettings.subtitle: Manage agents.list entries: workspaces, default routing, persona bootstrap files.
agentsSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to manage agents.
agentsSettings.selectAgentHint: Choose an entry to edit or inspect bootstrap Markdown under ~/.xopc/agents/<id>/bootstrap/.
agentsSettings.editAgentHint: Updates agents.list on the gateway. Paths are expanded (~ → home).
agentsSettings.addAgentHint: Same as CLI agents add: creates directories and seeds bootstrap templates.
agentsSettings.filesHint: Editable persona files (SOUL, IDENTITY, …). Changes save automatically after you stop typing; use Preview to render Markdown.
agentsSettings.confirmDelete: Remove this agent from config? Bindings referencing it will be stripped.
agentsSettings.confirmDeletePurge: Remove this agent and delete its workspace + ~/.xopc/agents/<id> data? This cannot be undone.
agentsSettings.toolsHint: Per-agent tool disables (merged with agents.defaults). Tools already disabled in defaults cannot be re-enabled here.

toolDescriptions.read_file: Read text and small files inside the agent workspace (paths are restricted to the workspace sandbox).
toolDescriptions.write_file: Create new files or overwrite existing ones under the workspace.
toolDescriptions.edit_file: Change existing files using locate-and-replace or patch-style edits.
toolDescriptions.list_dir: List files and subfolders in a workspace directory.
toolDescriptions.grep: Search file contents with regular expressions (similar to ripgrep).
toolDescriptions.find: Find files by name or glob pattern under the workspace.
toolDescriptions.shell: Run shell commands with workspace context — high impact; turn off for read-only or safer agents.
toolDescriptions.web_search: Search the public web for facts and pages newer than the model may know.
toolDescriptions.web_fetch: Fetch a URL and read its text content for the model.
toolDescriptions.send_message: Send outbound chat messages on connected channels (e.g. Telegram, CLI, gateway) when the agent replies.
toolDescriptions.send_media: Send images or other media attachments through those channels.
toolDescriptions.memory_search: Search indexed memories and notes stored for this agent.
toolDescriptions.memory_get: Load a specific memory entry or chunk by id.
toolDescriptions.curated_memory: Read or update curated markdown memories under the agent home directory.
toolDescriptions.session_search: Search across saved conversation transcripts and per-session summaries.
toolDescriptions.image: Analyze or describe images (vision) from the workspace or the current turn.
toolDescriptions.image_generate: Generate images using the configured image / image-generation model.
toolDescriptions.extensions: Expose tools registered by enabled extensions — disable to block all extension tools.

agentsSettings.skillsHint: Optional allowlist for <available_skills>. Inherit uses agents.defaults only; customize sets this agent’s skills array.
agentsSettings.channelsHint: config.bindings rows for this agent. Removing a rule updates the full bindings array on the gateway.
agentsSettings.cronHint: Isolated cron jobs can pin an agent id for the session key. Jobs without an agent id use the default agent and appear when that agent is selected.

providersSettings.subtitle: Provider API keys and OAuth. Keys you save here go to the gateway credential store.
providersSettings.intro: Search or open a group, expand a provider, paste a new key, then Save changes. OAuth opens in your browser when you choose it.
providersSettings.rotateHint: Rotating a key: expand the provider, paste the new secret, Save changes — no restart needed.
providersSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to manage provider credentials.
providersSettings.qwenKeyRegionHint: Keys are region-specific. Chat requests use the base URL from models.json (Models → providers.qwen.baseUrl). It must match the same region as the key you paste here (China DashScope vs international Model Studio).
providersSettings.metaMasked: Credential on file — enter a new key to replace.
providersSettings.metaWillSave: API key will be saved when you click Save changes.
providersSettings.envHint: API key is set via environment variable. Enter a new key above to override.
providersSettings.maskedStoredHint: Stored credential is not shown. Enter a new key above to replace it.
providersSettings.oauthHint: Use OAuth for secure authentication, or enter an API key manually.

modelsSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to edit models.json.
modelsSettings.subtitle: Custom providers and models (models.json). Changes apply after save; reload picks up disk edits.
modelsSettings.emptyDesc: Add OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, vLLM, etc.) and optional per-model overrides.
modelsSettings.addProviderSubtitle: Provider id must be unique (e.g. ollama, my-openai).
modelsSettings.apiKeyHint: Literal key, ENV name (uppercase), or shell command prefixed with !
modelsSettings.modelsEmpty: No custom models; built-in defaults apply where available.

channelsSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to edit channel settings.
channelsSettings.subtitle: Telegram and Weixin inbound channels. Changes are written to the gateway config file.
channelsSettings.removeChannelConfirm: Remove {{name}} settings and clear saved credentials on the gateway? You can configure again later.
channelsSettings.telegramSubtitle: Bot token, allowlists, and optional multi-account JSON.
channelsSettings.weixinSubtitle: Sign in with WeChat via QR (browser or CLI), then enable below. Credentials stay on the gateway host.
channelsSettings.telegramTokenDesc: From BotFather. Stored in the gateway config.
channelsSettings.allowFromDmDesc: Comma-separated user IDs allowed to DM the bot (when policy uses allowlist).
channelsSettings.multiAccountJsonDesc: Optional. Per-account botToken or tokenFile, policies, and groups. Empty {} uses the single token above only.
channelsSettings.weixinStepLogin: Use “Sign in with WeChat (QR)” below in this console, or see Channel documentation for CLI login.
channelsSettings.weixinStepEnable: Turn on Weixin below and save.
channelsSettings.weixinStepPairing: After QR login, DMs work immediately. Use allowlist DM policy only if you want to restrict who can message the bot.
channelsSettings.weixinAdvancedHint: Optional: allowlist, route tag, streaming, and per-account JSON—only if you need them.
channelsSettings.weixinAllowFromDesc: When DM policy is allowlist: comma-separated wxid / openid. Default pairing allows all contacts after QR login.
channelsSettings.weixinRouteTagDesc: Optional tag for routing; numeric or string.
channelsSettings.weixinDebugDesc: Extra logging for the Weixin channel.
channelsSettings.weixinAccountsJsonDesc: Per-account name, CDN base URL, route tag, and policies.
channelsSettings.weixinQrLoginDesc: Starts a login on the gateway. Scan with WeChat; when it succeeds, settings refresh automatically.
channelsSettings.weixinQrImageError: Could not render the QR code here. You can open the link in a new tab, or tap Regenerate to try again.
channelsSettings.weixinQrModalSubtitle: Use WeChat to scan the QR code below to connect.
channelsSettings.agentRoutingHint: Maps each channel account to an agent via config `bindings`. Inbound messages use a session key for that agent.
channelsSettings.jsonObjectAccounts: Accounts must be a JSON object

voiceSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to edit voice settings.
voiceSettings.subtitle: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech for channels. Keys can also be set via environment variables.

stt.title: Speech-to-text (STT)
stt.description: Transcribe inbound voice using Alibaba DashScope or OpenAI Whisper.
stt.enableDesc: When on, voice messages can be transcribed for the agent.
stt.apiKeyDesc: Optional if the key is already in the environment.
stt.fallbackDesc: Try the other provider if the primary request fails.

tts.title: Text-to-speech (TTS)
tts.description: Synthesize assistant replies as audio when enabled.
tts.enableDesc: When on, TTS runs according to the trigger mode below.
tts.triggerDescAlways: Apply TTS to all assistant messages.
tts.triggerDescInbound: Only reply with voice when the user sends voice.
tts.triggerDescTagged: Only when the [[tts]] directive is used.
tts.edgeHint: Microsoft Edge TTS — no API key required.

notes.title: Note
notes.duration: Long audio is split automatically; quality depends on provider and model.
notes.envVars: Environment variables: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY (when not set in this form).

gatewaySettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to load and edit gateway options.
gatewaySettings.subtitle: HTTP API access token and listen address. Values are stored in the gateway config file.
gatewaySettings.tokenExpired: Your session token was rejected. Update the client token or fix the access token in config.
gatewaySettings.tokenPlaceholder: Token stored in config (optional if using env)
gatewaySettings.tokenHelp: Used to authenticate HTTP/WebSocket API requests. You can also set XOPC_GATEWAY_TOKEN.
gatewaySettings.listenHint: Effective after gateway restart if changed outside this UI.
gatewaySettings.authModeNone: Auth mode is set to none — token in config may be ignored.

heartbeatSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to load and edit heartbeat options.
heartbeatSettings.subtitle: Periodic agent wake, optional delivery to a channel, and HEARTBEAT.md in your workspace. Stored in the gateway config file and workspace.
heartbeatSettings.triggerHint: Queues one heartbeat run (same as the timer). Skipped if HEARTBEAT.md is empty, outside active hours, or heartbeat is disabled.
heartbeatSettings.unsavedDoc: You have unsaved changes to HEARTBEAT.md.
heartbeatSettings.docHint: Tasks and reminders read by the agent on each heartbeat. Leave empty or comment-only to skip LLM calls and save tokens.
heartbeatSettings.intervalHint: Minimum 1 second. Saved to the gateway as milliseconds.
heartbeatSettings.intervalHintPreset: Quick preset or type seconds in the field.
heartbeatSettings.deliveryHint: Both channel and chat id are required to send non-silent replies somewhere. Otherwise the reply is only logged.
heartbeatSettings.promptHint: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt.
heartbeatSettings.ackMaxChars: Max reply length before treating as silent (ackMaxChars)
heartbeatSettings.isolatedSession: Use a fresh session key each run
heartbeatSettings.isolatedSessionHint: Avoids mixing heartbeat context with the main chat session.
heartbeatSettings.activeHoursHint: Restrict heartbeats to this window. Clear to run any time.

webSearchSettings.title: Web search
webSearchSettings.subtitle: Configure region and search providers for the web_search tool. Without API keys, a built-in HTML fallback is used.
webSearchSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to edit web search settings.
webSearchSettings.loadError: Failed to load web search settings
webSearchSettings.sectionRegionHint: Controls which zero-config HTML fallback is used when no API provider succeeds (China → Bing; otherwise DuckDuckGo).
webSearchSettings.sectionSearchHint: Providers are tried in order. Keys are stored in the gateway config file. Leave the list empty to use only the HTML fallback.
webSearchSettings.regionDesc: Auto uses your system timezone. Override if you are on a VPN or need a specific fallback.
webSearchSettings.maxResultsDesc: Used when the model does not pass a count (1–50).
webSearchSettings.apiKeyDesc: Optional for some setups. Leave masked to keep the saved value.
webSearchSettings.urlDesc: SearXNG base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080). No trailing slash required.
webSearchSettings.keyPlaceholder: API key or env var name
webSearchSettings.footerHint: HTML fallbacks depend on third-party pages and may change. For production, use a supported search API (Brave, Tavily, Bing, or self-hosted SearXNG).

appearanceSettings.subtitle: Language, appearance, and text size for daily use. Stored in this browser only.
appearanceSettings.themeDescription: Light, dark, or follow your system setting.
appearanceSettings.fontScaleDescription: Adjust text size in chat and reading areas.
